== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[It Could Be Worse (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|It Could Be Worse]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/it_could_be_worse_japanese_white_border/50629 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/fc3bcd3c0e9542dd9549f2920a45b904/IMG_20220607_0120.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(12, 24, 728, 1074)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c15269f384900b3414ed29a90024728ddc0e08ed5fcda04fef387d59572a4fae</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
